topic: At Aalborg you will spend every semester in a group
text:
Aalborg's teaching model is problem-based project work, and it is not a flavour on top of ordinary lectures — it is the structure of the degree. Every semester is built around a large written project done with a group of fellow students, alongside more conventional teaching. UNESCO has its only professorial chair in problem-based learning there, which gives some sense of how seriously the university takes it.

Worth thinking about honestly before you apply, in both directions. If you liked IB group work and Extended Essay research, this is close to an ideal fit. If your best work happens alone and you found group assignments the worst part of the Diploma, three years of this is a real consideration — not a reason to rule Aalborg out, but a reason to know what you are choosing.
attribution: Aalborg University's own description of its teaching model
